notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
smbmap maps shares and shows access permissions (READ/WRITE/NO ACCESS) per share per user. Cleaner permission output than smbclient -L. Also shows disk/IPC/printer share types.

=== CHAINING ===
smbmap permissions overview → identify WRITE shares for upload path → identify READ shares for credential hunting → smbclient for interactive file operations on interesting shares.

=== RECURSIVE ===
smbmap -R flag recursively lists all file contents of accessible shares — equivalent to a directory tree dump. Useful for identifying sensitive files without interactive browsing.
